title: Apply Wrong Password Jitter Only to Password Field
line: After a wrong password, only the password field shakes on the lock and login screens, not the avatar, username or messages around it.
explanation: The reject animation (RejectPasswordAnimation) was attached to the whole login block: mainBlock on the lock screen and the whole mainStack in the SDDM theme and in Plasma Login Manager's greeter. So on a wrong password the avatar, user list, username field, session picker and status message all shook and greyed out with the field. The animation now targets only the password row (field plus its unlock/login button), exposed by MainBlock/Login as passwordLayout/mainPasswordLayout; in the SDDM and PLM greeters it follows the current stack page, so the "other user" prompt works too.

commits.message:
lockscreen, sddm-theme: shake only the password field on failure

A wrong password made the whole login block shake and grey out, avatar,
user list and messages included, though only the password field was in
use. Run the reject animation on the password row alone in both themes.

BUG: 502538

greeter: shake only the password field on failed login

A failed login made the whole main stack shake and grey out, user list,
username field and session picker included, though only the password
was wrong. Run the reject animation on the password row alone instead.

BUG: 502538
